## Schema drift in `kalshi-ws`

Upstream spec at <https://docs.kalshi.com/asyncapi.yaml> differs from vendored `docs/specs/kalshi/asyncapi.yaml`.

## Channels added

- `ebattle_scores`

## Channels modified

- `root`

### info

- `info.description` changed: `"WebSocket API for receiving real-time market data notifications and updates on Kalshi.\n\nThis API provides multiple c…` → `"WebSocket API for receiving real-time market data notifications and updates on Kalshi.\n\nThis API provides multiple c…`

## What to do

### Adopt

```bash
curl -fsSL https://docs.kalshi.com/asyncapi.yaml -o docs/specs/kalshi/asyncapi.yaml
```

### Or acknowledge

Record the decision in `docs/specs/.drift-acknowledged.json` and this stops
refiling until upstream changes or we adopt part of it:

```json
  "kalshi-ws": {
    "diff_sha256": "7a09009f7ccff02c68ebab5b80141459b655586bb68f8bdf293fedc25b428464",
    "reason": "why this will not be synced",
    "acknowledged": "YYYY-MM-DD"
  }
```
